market_sizing.target_buyer: Founder / owner-operator. Almost always also the maker. Production assistant joins at AU$500K revenue; production lead at AU$1.5M+.
market_sizing.business_count_au: Estimated 2,500-5,000 active AU candle / soap / home-fragrance SMBs selling commercially. Long tail of Etsy hobbyists is much larger (probably 10-20K hobby sellers) but most are sub-AU$50K revenue and not Manuva ICP. AU candle market AU$130-294M (Expert Market Research / IMARC); soap/home-fragrance adds AU$200-400M. Concentrated in Byron Bay, Fremantle, Blue Mountains, Mornington Peninsula. [uncertain]
market_sizing.business_count_secondary: US: ~25,000-50,000 candle/soap businesses (Soapmaking Forum + handmade marketplaces). UK: ~3,000-6,000. NZ: ~500-1,000. CA: ~2,000-4,000. [uncertain]
market_sizing.typical_size: 1-3 employees. Revenue AU$80K-$1.5M. Top quartile sits at AU$1-5M (Glasshouse, Circa, Palm Beach, Ecoya are outliers above AU$10M).
market_sizing.growth_trend: AU candle market 4.4-7.8% CAGR (130→200M by 2035 / 294→623M by 2033 depending on source). Home fragrance broader 6.2-10.5% CAGR. Handmade/artisanal candles fastest-growing sub-segment within the market — favours fragmented indie cohort over big players.

fit_and_timing.roadmap_dependency: Pre-launch lot tracking (shipped) sufficient. Xero integration meaningfully improves wholesale-heavy brands. Faire integration valuable but not blocking.
fit_and_timing.typical_tier: Starter ($99) for solo / hobby-to-pro; Growth ($249) primary; Pro ($499) for wholesale-heavy multi-channel brands like Palm Beach or Circa-tier.
fit_and_timing.regulatory_burden: 2 — minor ACCC labelling, ingredient declarations, AS/NZS candle safety standards. No TGA/AICIS unless they make soap with imported ingredients. Lighter than cosmetics.

economics.incumbent_pricing: Craftybase is the DOMINANT tool — soap and candle makers are Craftybase's core ICP. Indie tier US$39, Business US$199. Hard ceilings at 250 / 1,000 / 5,000 order-lines/mo. Brands hitting 1,000+ orders/mo (most AU$500K+ revenue brands) face the painful Indie→Business cliff. Katana ~10%. Spreadsheets ~30-40% of sub-AU$200K cohort.
economics.willingness_to_pay_aud: AU$99-$249/mo realistic. WTP slightly lower than skincare because regulatory pain is lighter. Growth tier hits at AU$25K+/mo revenue.
economics.estimated_arpu_aud: AU$185 blended (Starter 45% / Growth 45% / Pro 10%) — lowest blended ARPU of the Tier-A beauty/lifestyle segments because Starter share is higher.
economics.expansion_revenue_potential: 4 — clear path Starter→Growth as wholesale scales; Pro tier unlocked when 3+ channels active. Wholesale pricing tier features are a key upgrade driver.
economics.churn_risk: 3 — significant solo-founder pause/exit rate (~15-20% annual for sub-AU$200K cohort). Mitigation: prioritise brands at AU$25K+/mo revenue who have crossed the survival threshold.
economics.cac_estimate_aud: Cash CAC AU$30-100 (very community-driven; FB group + Etsy graduate funnel is essentially free). Founder-time CAC ~5-8 hours × AU$150 = AU$750-1,200. Total ~AU$800-1,300.
economics.ltv_cac_ratio: ~2.7-4.4:1 fully loaded. Acceptable but thinner than skincare/SPF.
economics.wholesale_b2b_mix: 40-65% wholesale — HIGH. Most AU candle SMBs sell B2B to gift stores, florists, boutique hotels, salons. This is the highest-wholesale-mix Tier-A segment.

where_they_live.industry_facebook_group_size: ~30,000-60,000 combined AU candle/soap FB group members across 4-6 active groups [uncertain]
where_they_live.podcasts_voices: 1) The Candle Making Business Podcast (US but global audience). 2) Elly's Everyday (AU soap/candle YouTube + blog). 3) CandleScience newsletter. 4) Lone Star Candle Supply community. 5) Soap Queen (Brambleberry). 6) Australian Soaping and Candle Conference speakers.

outreach_fit.cold_outbound_feasibility: 4 — FB group posts, Reddit AMAs, and direct DMs are highly accepted (community norm). Cold email moderate. Easiest cold outbound surface of any Tier-A segment.
outreach_fit.inbound_content_fit: 5 — 'Outgrowing Craftybase: when to switch', 'Wholesale pricing tiers for candle makers', 'Tracking fragrance oil lots' all have clear search volume. Strong YouTube tutorial appetite.
outreach_fit.founder_market_fit_proxy: 4 — buyer trusts an outsider easily because the segment self-identifies as 'business operators' not 'chemists'. Best founder-market-fit of any beauty/lifestyle segment.
outreach_fit.case_study_acquisition_cost: Easy — 5-8 paying reference customers in 60 days is realistic via FB group + Reddit posts.

foot_in_door_fit.trial_to_paid_benchmark: Opt-in trial 12-15% (community-driven, high-curiosity); CC-required 32-38%; design partner 60-70%. The free 30-day trial works exceptionally well here because makers self-serve.
foot_in_door_fit.recommended_foot_in_door_motion: Phase 1 (months 0-3): 14-day free trial (no CC) + 5 design partners from FB group + targeted 'Craftybase graduate' campaign aimed at brands hitting the 1,000-order ceiling. Founder-led posts in 'Australian candle makers' + 'Australian Soapmakers' FB groups offering free 6mo + case study to brands at AU$25K+/mo revenue. Pair with one piece of pillar content ('Outgrowing Craftybase: a guide for AU candle/soap makers'). This is the highest-leverage segment for Phase 1 self-serve motion.
foot_in_door_fit.rollout_phase: Phase 1 (months 0-3) — top-2 segment, especially for self-serve volume

competitive_context.current_dominant_tool: Craftybase ~50-60% share of the make-tool-purchasing cohort (this is their core market). Spreadsheets ~30%. Katana ~5%. Cin7 ~5%. Notion/Airtable ~3%.
competitive_context.switching_pain: 3 — SKU counts moderate (50-200), but historical batch data + supplier records take 1-2 weeks to migrate. CSV import critical.
competitive_context.competitor_gaps_for_this_segment: Craftybase order-line ceiling is the single biggest pain (Indie 250 → Business 1,000 → Premium 5,000, with a Indie→Business price jump from US$39 to US$199). No BOM versioning. Weak production-order workflow (just 'manufactures'). No native Xero integration deeper than CSV. Manuva wedge: flat AU pricing, no order-line ceiling, true production orders, BOM versioning for recipe iteration, Xero integration on roadmap.
competitive_context.user_satisfaction_signals: Craftybase Capterra: 4.5+ stars overall but order-line ceiling appears repeatedly in 3-star reviews. Reddit r/candlemaking quarterly thread: 'I just got the Craftybase upgrade prompt and the price tripled — what do you use?' Multiple. Indie→Business cliff at US$89→$199 (or $39→$199 depending on order volume) is the documented pain.
competitive_context.competitor_concentration: Concentrated — Craftybase is the single largest incumbent in this segment, the only Tier-A segment where one tool has >50% share.
competitive_context.integration_dependency_list: Must-have: Shopify, Xero (roadmap — critical), Faire (wholesale — high-impact), Etsy (most graduates run a residual Etsy store). Klaviyo. Aus Post / Shippit / Sendle for shipping.

partner_channels.industry_association_sponsorship: Australian Soaping and Candle Conference — annual sponsorship AU$500-3K (high-leverage, low-cost). Reed Gift Fairs — booth AU$5-15K (target = gift-store buyers but also brands network there). Aussie Candle Supplies / Candle Supply / Scents and Suds — supplier co-marketing (could be free or affiliate-based; very high leverage). makesy AU community partnership.

profitability_math.realistic_12mo_customer_count_solo: 30-60 paying customers by month 12. Highest-volume Tier-A segment because self-serve works and community channels are free. Conservative: 25. Optimistic: 80.
profitability_math.realistic_12mo_mrr_contribution_aud: AU$5,500-11,100 MRR at AU$185 ARPU (~40 customers midpoint)
profitability_math.path_to_first_3k_5k_mrr_aud: Month 0-2: write 'Outgrowing Craftybase' pillar content + 5 supporting articles; build a Craftybase-import tool (CSV mapper). Month 2-4: post in 'Australian candle makers' + 'Australian Soapmakers' FB groups offering 'free for 6 months + we'll migrate your data' to 8-10 design partners. Month 4-6: case-study publish + Reddit AMA + supplier co-marketing (Aussie Candle Supplies, Scents and Suds). Month 6-12: founder-led + self-serve at AU$185 blended × 35-50 customers = AU$6,500-9,250 MRR from this segment alone. The single highest-MRR-per-month segment for solo bandwidth.
profitability_math.solo_founder_bandwidth_fit: 5 — segment self-serves, low support load, generous community helps each other. Ceiling ~80-120 active customers.
profitability_math.gross_margin_sensitivity: Low — minimal hand-holding; community absorbs support load via FB groups.
profitability_math.priority_ranking: 1 — Co-#1 segment with indie skincare. Highest realistic 12-month customer volume, lowest CAC, best community channels, dominant Craftybase incumbent has a documented switching pain (order-line ceiling) that Manuva removes. Lower ARPU offset by higher volume.
profitability_math.risks_and_notes: Risks: (1) Lower ARPU means hitting AU$1M ARR requires high customer counts (450+). (2) Solo-founder churn rate in this cohort is real — bias toward >AU$25K/mo revenue brands. (3) Craftybase has 10+ years of brand affinity; pure 'cheaper' positioning won't win. Lead with 'true production orders + BOM versioning + no order-line ceiling + AU-priced'. (4) Wholesale pricing tier feature must be solid — most candle brands need it. Verify Manuva supports tier-based pricing per customer. (5) Build a one-click Craftybase CSV import — it's the deal-closer.
